ties.note: China is Russia's #1 crude buyer, ~2.2 mb/d in 2024, plus Power of Siberia gas
Russia became India's top crude supplier, ~1.7 mb/d and ~37% of imports in 2024
Russia is Türkiye's largest gas supplier via TurkStream/Blue Stream pipelines
Hungary still takes Russian pipeline gas via TurkStream/Balkan route after Ukraine transit ended
Serbia receives Russian gas via the TurkStream/Balkan Stream interconnector
Belarus depends almost entirely on Russian oil and gas, transited via Druzhba and Yamal
Norway supplies ~48% of Germany's gas, its largest single source in 2024
Norway is the UK's largest gas import source, ~43% of gross supply in 2024
Norway pipes gas directly to France and is a top EU supplier (~30% of EU imports)
Qatar is one of South Korea's largest LNG suppliers, ~$6.6B in 2024
China was Qatar's top LNG buyer in 2024 (~$10.6B) under long-term contracts
Qatar is India's dominant LNG supplier, ~$6.4B in 2024
Qatar is Pakistan's main LNG supplier under long-term deals, ~$3.5B in 2024
Netherlands is a top European destination for US LNG (Gate/Rotterdam terminals)
China is Saudi Arabia's single largest crude buyer, ~$48B in 2024
Saudi Arabia is Japan's leading crude supplier; ~$29B of exports in 2024
~96% of Canada's crude exports go to the US; Canada is #1 US crude supplier (~60% of imports)
Algeria is Italy's top pipeline gas supplier via Transmed, ~46% of Algerian gas exports in 2024
Algeria supplies ~39% of Spanish gas imports via the Medgaz pipeline (2024)
Iran is Türkiye's third-largest gas supplier (~13.6% share, 7 bcm) via Tabriz-Ankara pipeline in 2024
